sourceTitle: Build strategic A/B tests to grow your ad performance.
originalTitle: Build strategic A/B tests to grow your ad performance.

blocks.text: In an era of rapid AI innovation, experimentation can serve as a strategic compass. In the latest episode of Ads Decoded, Ads Product Liaison Ginny Marvin sits down with product leads Sagar Shah and Al Nevarez to explore how A/B testing validates AI Max features, budget shifts, and Smart Bidding strategies.
blocks.zh: 在AI快速创新的时代，实验可以充当战略指南针。在最新一期的《Ads Decoded》中，广告产品联络人Ginny Marvin与产品负责人Sagar Shah和Al Nevarez展开对话，探讨A/B测试如何验证AI Max功能、预算调整和Smart Bidding策略。
blocks.en: In an era of rapid AI innovation, experimentation can serve as a strategic compass. In the latest episode of Ads Decoded, Ads Product Liaison Ginny Marvin sits down with product leads Sagar Shah and Al Nevarez to explore how A/B testing validates AI Max features, budget shifts, and Smart Bidding strategies.

blocks.text: Three key rules to guide your testing:
blocks.zh: 指导您进行测试的三条关键规则：
blocks.en: Three key rules to guide your testing:

blocks.text: Start with templated setups: Pre-built templates isolate single variables, split traffic 50/50, and minimize setup errors for cleaner data.
blocks.zh: 从模板化设置开始：预构建的模板可隔离单一变量，按50/50比例拆分流量，并尽量减少设置错误，以获得更干净的数据。
blocks.en: Start with templated setups: Pre-built templates isolate single variables, split traffic 50/50, and minimize setup errors for cleaner data.

blocks.text: Focus on business outcomes: Measure qualified conversions rather than shallow proxies, and give tests four to six weeks to account for conversion lag.
blocks.zh: 关注业务成果：衡量合格转化，而不是浅层代理指标，并给测试留出四到六周时间，以考虑转化延迟。
blocks.en: Focus on business outcomes: Measure qualified conversions rather than shallow proxies, and give tests four to six weeks to account for conversion lag.

blocks.text: Match confidence to decision scope: An 80% confidence interval works well for directional tweaks. Reserve 95% certainty for major structural overhauls.
blocks.zh: 将置信度与决策范围相匹配：80%的置信区间适用于方向性调整。请将95%的确定性保留给重大结构性变革。
blocks.en: Match confidence to decision scope: An 80% confidence interval works well for directional tweaks. Reserve 95% certainty for major structural overhauls.

blocks.text: Explore the Experiments tab in Google Ads, test with confidence, and let data prove the value before scaling.
blocks.zh: 探索Google Ads中的“实验”标签页，放心进行测试，并在扩大规模之前让数据证明价值。
blocks.en: Explore the Experiments tab in Google Ads, test with confidence, and let data prove the value before scaling.
